description: This file defines the class 'contextMenu' which manages context menu items for a web application, including adding menu items, loading from files, and generating JavaScript code for menu registration.

classes.name: contextMenu
classes.description: A class that manages context menu items, including adding items, loading definitions from files, and generating associated JavaScript code.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to register the context menu object with the registered menu items.

methods.name: addMenuItem
methods.description: Adds a menu item to the context menu after checking user access permissions.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads menu item definitions from an external PHP file based on a given name.

methods.name: loadFromDef
methods.description: Loads menu items from a provided definition array and sets the object name.
